records.title: Finch Robot Web Controller
records.publicText: The Finch Robot Web Controller was a Spring 2026 team coursework project for Software Design and Analysis that allowed users to control BirdBrain Finch 2.0 robots through browser interfaces, room codes, multiplayer lobbies, and real-time controller screens. The project used Python, Flask, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Socket.IO, and Finch robotics tools. Mark’s individual work is documented in a separate contribution record.
records.shortText: Spring 2026 team project for controlling Finch 2.0 robots through browser-based multiplayer controller screens.
records.portfolioLocation: Software Design and Analysis portfolio section

records.title: Operating Systems C Projects

The work included both solo and shared coursework, with public portfolio documentation kept separate from original course repositories that may require access.

records.title: Sleep Efficiency Analysis
records.publicText: Sleep Efficiency Analysis was a Fall 2024 team Data Science coursework project using a publicly available Kaggle sleep-efficiency dataset. The team performed data cleaning, visualization, variance inflation factor checks, and linear regression to explore relationships in the dataset.
